_comment: Shared MCP servers for the Regen Web3 Toolkit. Committed so the whole team inherits the
same config rather than each person wiring it up locally.
The Linear server is for CONVERSATIONAL work — marking something done, asking what is in
the current cycle, adding a comment. Bulk and deterministic work goes through
scripts/linear/* instead, because those runs need to be reproducible and idempotent.
See skills/linear-sync/SKILL.md for which to reach for, and for the ownership boundary:
anything changed here that belongs to a repo-owned field is overwritten by the next apply.
Endpoint probed 2026-08-09: https://mcp.linear.app/mcp returns 401 (exists, wants auth);
the /sse path returns 404. Authentication is interactive OAuth on first use, so this will
not work in a headless or cron run.
